To multiply 1234 by 5678, you can use the standard multiplication method. Here is the step-by-step calculation:

```
          1234
       x  5678
    __________
         9872   (1234 * 8)
        7404    (1234 * 7, shift one position to the left)
       6170     (1234 * 6, shift two positions to the left)
      4936      (1234 * 5, shift three positions to the left)
    __________
     7006652
```

So, 1234 multiplied by 5678 equals 7,006,652.
